thinking about these 2 ideas in tandem

1. Jung on the difficulty of defining a man on an absolute basis - we have only relative.

2. Sartre on how a man is defined by "encountering himself" - essence via leap towards existence

message is the same: immerse yourself in the world. https://t.co/Z0Zli5LMtD
